# Requirements Quality Checklist: 002-products-discount-filter

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirements in spec.md and the design inputs in plan.md (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) before plan and tasks are approved
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the list's behavior while results for a new minimum discount are loading specified (previous list kept, or a loading state)? [Gap, Spec PROD-004 §UI] — Evidence: spec.md:265, spec.md:349 (PROD-004-S16), spec.md:380
- [x] CHK002 - Is an accessible name / label association required for the "Giảm giá" control, as NFR-044 requires for the price inputs? [Gap, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements] — Evidence: spec.md:265, spec.md:365 (NFR-044 MODIFIED)
- [x] CHK003 - Is it specified where the clear-filter button is available — only in the empty state, or also when results exist? [Completeness, Spec PROD-002 §Empty result] — Evidence: spec.md:75
- [x] CHK004 - Is the narrow-screen layout of the new control either specified or listed in Out of Scope (002-ADR-4 says "not optimised here")? [Gap, Spec §Scope, 002-ADR-4] — Evidence: spec.md:57
- [x] CHK005 - Are the response fields for a discount-filtered request (`products`, `total`, `skip`, `limit`) fully stated, including that `total` counts the filtered set? [Completeness, Spec PROD-004 §API] — Evidence: spec.md:234, spec.md:240
- [x] CHK006 - Does the spec say whether a product's discount shown on the card must match the value used by the filter (same stored `discountPercentage`)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — Evidence: spec.md:527

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "any other value" in PROD-004 explicit about values with surrounding spaces (`" 10"`) or decimals (`"10.0"`), which the price filter treats differently (it trims)? [Ambiguity, Spec PROD-004 §API] — Evidence: spec.md:243, spec.md:342 (PROD-004-S15)
- [x] CHK008 - Is "at least" (inclusive) stated for every threshold, not only for 10%? [Clarity, Spec PROD-004 §API] — Evidence: spec.md:237
- [x] CHK009 - Is SC-002's measurement method stated in this spec, rather than "as for change 001"? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002] — Evidence: spec.md:34–38
- [x] CHK010 - Is the order of the five choices and the default ("Tất cả") stated unambiguously in one place? [Clarity, Spec PROD-004 §UI] — Evidence: spec.md:254, spec.md:258
- [x] CHK011 - Is "applied as soon as it is chosen" defined precisely enough to tell what happens when the same choice is selected again (no new history entry)? [Clarity, Spec PROD-002 §URL state] — Evidence: spec.md:92

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Is the common empty-state description "… Thử nới khoảng giá hoặc xoá bộ lọc." still the intended text when only the discount filter empties the list (it mentions only the price range)? [Consistency, Spec PROD-002 §Empty result, PROD-002-S21] — Evidence: spec.md:70–73, spec.md:109 (PROD-002-S4), spec.md:178 (S21), spec.md:206 (S26)
- [x] CHK013 - Do the URL-state rules for `minDiscount` (invalid / empty / repeated → ignored in the UI) and the API rules (→ 400) describe the same set of invalid values? [Consistency, Spec PROD-002 §URL state, PROD-004 §API] — Evidence: spec.md:89, spec.md:243
- [x] CHK014 - Are the URL key order and the keys kept / dropped consistent across every action row, including Search and Change page? [Consistency, Spec PROD-002 §URL state] — Evidence: spec.md:93
- [x] CHK015 - Are the terms "minimum discount", "discount filter" and "Giảm giá" used consistently, and is "minimum discount" defined in the glossary? [Consistency, Gap, specs/_system/glossary.md] — Evidence: specs/_system/glossary.md:8
- [x] CHK016 - Does NFR-004 (modified) use the same wording of the target as SC-002 (filters alone or combined)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §Non-Functional Requirements] — Evidence: spec.md:34, spec.md:360

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are alternate flows covered for changing the discount after a price range and keyword are already applied, and the reverse order? [Coverage, Spec PROD-002-S16, S23] — Evidence: spec.md:147 (PROD-002-S16), spec.md:190 (S23), spec.md:215 (S27)
- [x] CHK021 - Are recovery paths stated for every error scenario at P1/P2 (400, load error, empty state)? [Coverage, Spec PROD-004-S5, PROD-002-S21, S26] — Evidence: spec.md:293 (PROD-004-S5), spec.md:178 (PROD-002-S21), spec.md:206 (PROD-002-S26)
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the discount filter combined with the 5-second delete undo (a product pending deletion while the filter changes)? [Coverage, Gap] — Evidence: spec.md:58

## Edge Case Coverage

[Edge Case, Spec PROD-004-S1, S8] — Evidence: spec.md:275 (PROD-004-S1, 10%), spec.md:309 (S8, 50%), spec.md:427 (002-ADR-2, one comparison for every threshold); accepted without more scenarios (reviewer, 2026-11-13)
- [x] CHK024 - Is the case of products whose stored discount is outside 0–100 (data entered before validation, if any) addressed or ruled out? [Edge Case, Assumption, specs/_system/domain-model.md] — Evidence: spec.md:237, specs/_system/domain-model.md:27
